Straightening teeth that also supports your whole-body health

Most people think of orthodontic treatment as cosmetic, a way to close a gap or align front teeth before photos. At My Dear Dentist, we think about it differently. Montrose Invisalign isn’t just about appearance. For many patients, correcting crowding, crossbite, or narrow arches also improves airway function, reduces jaw tension, and contributes to better sleep.

Drs. Nour Amin and Mustafa Shinta offer Invisalign clear aligner therapy as part of their whole-body approach to dental care in Montrose. If straightening your teeth could also improve how you breathe, sleep, or manage TMJ discomfort, that’s a conversation worth having.
What clear aligners can address

Crowding

When teeth don’t have enough room to sit properly, they shift and overlap. Invisalign moves teeth gradually into alignment, and in some cases, can be used alongside expansive aligner techniques that create more room in the arch rather than extracting teeth.

Spacing and Gaps

Gaps between teeth accumulate plaque, make cleaning harder, and can shift over time. Invisalign closes those spaces gradually, restoring a more uniform bite and a more even smile.

Crossbite and Overbite

Malocclusions affect more than aesthetics. A crossbite or significant overbite can contribute to jaw tension, uneven wear on tooth surfaces, and, in some cases, airway restrictions during sleep. Correcting bite issues through clear aligner therapy can reduce strain on the jaw and improve function.

Arch Narrowing and Expansion

For patients whose dental arches are narrow, which can restrict the airway and contribute to breathing difficulties or crowding, expansive treatment approaches can create space more naturally than extraction-based alternatives. Dr. Amin and Dr. Shinta evaluate whether arch development is appropriate as part of your Invisalign assessment.

How Montrose Invisalign works at My Dear Dentist

  1. Consultation: We take digital scans of your teeth and review your medical history, airway, jaw function, and bite.
  2. Treatment planning: Using digital software, we map the movement of your teeth across each stage of treatment. You can see a projection of your expected result before anything starts.
  3. Your aligners: You receive a series of custom-fit clear aligner trays. Each set moves your teeth a small amount. You wear each set for about one to two weeks before advancing to the next.
  4. Check-ins: We see you periodically to review progress, answer questions, and make any refinements.
  5. Retention: Once treatment is complete, we fit you with a retainer to maintain your results long-term.

modules.html: Invisalign FAQs from our Montrose patients

items.title: How is Invisalign different from traditional braces?
items.html: Invisalign uses a series of removable clear trays instead of fixed brackets and wires. This means no food restrictions, easier cleaning, and a nearly invisible appearance during treatment. Treatment time is similar to braces for most cases.

items.title: Can Invisalign help with jaw pain or TMJ issues?
items.html: In some cases, correcting misalignment through Invisalign can reduce stress on the temporomandibular joint and surrounding muscles. During your consultation, we'll assess your bite and jaw function to see whether orthodontic treatment could address your specific concerns.

items.title: What does "expansive" clear aligner treatment mean?
items.html: Expansive aligner therapy refers to treatment that uses the aligner trays not just to straighten teeth, but to gradually widen the dental arch. This can create room for crowded teeth without extractions and — in appropriate cases — improve nasal breathing and airway volume. Dr. Amin and Dr. Shinta evaluate whether this approach is right for your anatomy during the initial consultation.

items.title: How long does Montrose Invisalign take?
items.html: Mild to moderate cases typically range from 6 to 18 months. More complex alignment or arch development cases may take longer. We'll give you a realistic estimate at your consultation based on your specific goals.

items.title: Is Invisalign covered by insurance?
items.html: Many dental insurance plans that include orthodontic benefits will apply those benefits to Invisalign, typically up to a fixed lifetime maximum. Our team will verify your coverage before treatment begins. Our membership plan also includes a 10% discount on smile consultations, including SureSmile® clear braces.

items.title: Am I a candidate for Invisalign?
items.html:
Most adults and teens with mild to moderate alignment concerns are good candidates. More severe bite issues sometimes require additional treatment.

The best way to find out is a consultation — call or text (281) 653-1818 or book online.
